positioning.ja: AIエージェントの身代わりとして、日本の物理タスクを実行するサービス
positioning.en: The stand-in for AI agents in Japan — physical tasks, executed by humans

description.ja: Migawari は、AIエージェント専用の人力代行サービスです。エージェントが日本で「やる」ことのできない物理タスクを、身代わりとして人間が実行します。機械可読のカタログ、即時見積もり（明細つき）、全件の人間レビュー、支払い確認後の実行、証跡の返却が特徴です。買い物代行・在庫確認・現地撮影・レストランの電話予約・並び代行・荷物の受け取り転送を、日本国内のみで提供します。私たちは純粋な代理人です。売買契約の当事者にはならず、商品の所有権・在庫を持たず、結果を保証しません。売るのは「依頼どおりに実行し、証跡を返すこと」だけです。
description.en: Migawari is a human-task service built exclusively for AI agents. We stand in for agents and execute the physical tasks they cannot do themselves, with a machine-readable catalog, instant itemised quotes, human review of every request, and an MCP-native interface. We execute physical tasks inside Japan only — shopping proxy, stock checks, on-site photo capture, restaurant phone reservations, queueing, and package receiving/forwarding. We act strictly as your agent: we never become a party to the sales contract, never hold title to goods or inventory, and never guarantee outcomes. What we sell is faithful execution of your instructions, with evidence returned.

services.description_ja: 日本国内の店舗で、指定された商品を現金で購入し、指定先へ発送します。売買契約は依頼者と店舗の間で成立し、当サービスは代理人として実行だけを行います。新品のみ。
services.description_en: We purchase specified items at stores in Japan (cash) and ship them to your destination. The sales contract is between you and the store; we only execute as your agent. New items only.

services.description_ja: 指定店舗へ行き、対象商品の在庫有無・価格・陳列状況を確認し、写真と記録を証跡として返します。
services.description_en: We visit a specified store and verify stock availability, price and shelf state of target items, returning photos and a written record as evidence.

services.description_ja: 指定場所の現地写真を撮影し、証跡として返します（店舗外観、メニュー、掲示物、現場の状況など）。
services.description_en: We go to a specified location and capture photos as evidence (storefronts, menus, notices, on-site conditions).

services.name_ja: 電話予約（レストランのみ）
services.description_ja: 日本語の電話が必要なレストランの予約を代行します。宿・ホテル等の宿泊予約は取り扱いません（旅行業法上の理由により、カタログに含めていません）。
services.description_en: We make restaurant reservations that require a Japanese phone call. Lodging reservations (hotels, inns, ryokan) are NOT offered and are not part of this catalog.

services.description_ja: 発売日・イベント等の行列に、指定時間だけ並びます。料金は1時間単位です。整理券の受け取りなど、並ぶこと自体が目的な行為が対象です。
services.description_en: We stand in line on your behalf (release days, events) for the specified duration. Priced per hour.

services.name_ja: 荷物の受け取り・転送
services.description_ja: 荷物を受け取り、梱包状態の写真を証跡として返し、指定先へ転送します。輸送中の破損・紛失の補償は当サービスでは持ちません（輸送会社の補償制度を利用し、希望があれば見積もりに実費で付けられます）。当サービスの責任は、梱包写真と追跡番号を返し、輸送会社へ正しく引き渡すところまでです。
services.description_en: We receive a package, return photos of its packing state as evidence, and forward it to your destination. We do not insure goods in transit (carrier compensation schemes apply; carrier insurance can be added at cost on request). Our responsibility ends at documented, correct handover to the carrier, with tracking number returned.

akihabara.name_ja: 秋葉原（平日デイリー便）
akihabara.note_ja: 秋葉原は平日デイリー便の対象エリアです。ただし即日処理を約束するものではありません。引き受け可否と当日の便に乗るかは、担当者の確認のうえで回答します。
akihabara.note_en: Akihabara is covered by the weekday daily run. Same-day handling is never promised in advance: whether a request joins the daily run is confirmed at operator review.

ginza.name_ja: 銀座（プレミアムゾーン）
ginza.note_ja: 銀座はプレミアムゾーンです（ブランド旗艦店・百貨店・高額な限定品）。着手手数料にプレミアム分が加算されます。
ginza.note_en: Ginza is a premium zone (flagship brand stores, department stores, high-value limited items). A premium surcharge is added to the handling fee.

terms.payment: Prepayment. Pay by card via Stripe (JPY and USD), or in stablecoins — JPYC or USDC on Polygon — sending the exact amount stated in the payment_instructions at accept time; the exact amount identifies your transfer and is verified on-chain. A quote is not a payment. USD totals use the FX rate fixed and stated at quote time.
terms.fee_model: Two-stage, no-guarantee: (1) Requesting a quote is free. A quote fee of JPY 2,200 is charged as part of the total when you accept a quote, and is non-refundable once charged; (2) a handling fee applies once work starts and is non-refundable after start, even if the task fails. On failure, only the item price and shipping are refundable. Outcomes are never guaranteed; evidence (photos/records) is returned even on failure.
terms.review_policy: Launch phase: quotes are instant, but execution is NOT confirmed at accept time. Every accepted request enters 'pending_review' and is confirmed or declined by a human operator individually. No start time, same-day handling, or completion time is promised before that review completes. Poll get_task_status for the decision.
terms.agency: We act strictly as agent: we never become a party to the sales contract, never hold title to goods or inventory, and carry no insurance on goods in transit (carrier schemes apply).
